items.s: Leonardo Carvalho, Groton School Class of 2028. Goaltender, student researcher, founder of OCAPEX, violist. Research, product, hockey and music.
How Leonardo Carvalho thinks, and what connects goaltending, research, a music nonprofit and building things with friends.

A comparative pharmacovigilance analysis of the 486 FDA adverse-event cases filed for aducanumab from 2016 to 2024, set beside lecanemab and donanemab. Independent research by Leonardo Carvalho, advised by Dr. Sujata K. Bhatia of Harvard University.
Daedalus, a cooperative survival-horror game in development for Roblox, set in a changing labyrinth. Leonardo Carvalho is the main builder on the three-person Gompurkle team.
FreeCode Juniors, free Scratch and Python classes for children ages eight and up at Nova Southeastern University’s Alvin Sherman Library. Leonardo Carvalho is co-founder and instructor.

Genuvalens: the design and simulation of an assist-as-needed knee exoskeleton for ACL-reconstruction rehabilitation. An individual project by Leonardo Carvalho with guidance from Georgia Tech’s EPIC Lab, summer 2026.

Loquar, a language-learning web app in development that teaches Mandarin through conversation in an open world. Leonardo Carvalho is co-founder and CTO.
OCAPEX, a student-led 501(c)(3) music nonprofit founded by Leonardo Carvalho in 2022 that brings performances to senior living communities, hospitals and community events across South Florida.
